raw_data: c3_prefilter.json (243 fan-8 mech-clean candidates), c3_bracket_raw.json (e10n-neighborhood >=0.6 mm)
why_graded: place_search_002z.evaluate's 1.20 mm binary gate is dead for every c2 pose (trunk_120=None) and stays dead for every card-3 divider move. But the real arbiter can STAGE the trunk on F.Cu with vias, so we rank by how much a third part WIDENS the B.Cu corridor rather than by pass/fail. base (c2) trunk_best_w: e10n=0.40 mm, e10/w05/E2r < 0.40 mm (dead).

winner.why_R79: R79 is the U18.2->R79.2 tap sitting at y=67.8, exactly where the trunk climbs from R75.2 (y=62) to D9.1 (y=72.5). Nudging it east thins the fanout band at the trunk crossing. The e10n U18 north pose (y=72.9) is REQUIRED -- at y=72.4 (e10) the same R79 move yields trunk=None.

dead_ends_proven.single_divider_other_than_R79east_on_e10: R78/R80/R81/R82/R83 and all R79 poses except (9.825,67.825) do not widen the trunk beyond the base on any of the four bases (242 of 243 candidates).
dead_ends_proven.R79east_on_other_bases: e10+R79east=None, w05+R79east=None, E2r+R79east breaks fanout to 7. Only e10n benefits.
dead_ends_proven.card4_divider_pairs: 0 of the swept R78/R79/R80/R81 east-shift pairs reach even 1.0 mm; spreading the divider column does NOT reach the 1.20 mm floor.
dead_ends_proven.q3_subcluster: R75+U18+Q3 caps at 0.40 mm; R75+U18+R79east+Q3 stays at 0.80 mm. Q3 is not a trunk lever (the trunk exits north to D9, not south past Q3).

conclusion: Cardinality 3 is NOT dry but is MARGINAL: exactly one lever (e10n + R79 east) widens the B.Cu western BPP trunk, from 0.40 to 0.80 mm -- still below the 1.20 mm floor. Whether it closes BAT_PROTECTED_P R75.2->U11.2 depends on the arbiter's F.Cu staging, which only a real run can decide. The four ranked candidates (c3_00..c3_03) bracket this lever across the U18 x-axis and R79 step for the supervised runs.
